name_reason: Compliant and accurate: data_fd2_ game-global prefix; 'chapter_intro' domain (between-chapter intro/save panel); 'menu_cursor_state' descriptor correctly captures both the data role (state var) and meaning (radio-menu cursor). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix). The numeric range 0..5 is a domain value range, not encoded in the name.
purpose: Chapter-intro between-chapter menu radio cursor / commit-state word: selected menu option (0..4), with 5 reserved as the special-hotkey commit value; shared by the intro panel and its sub-flows (shop/equip/give/recruitment).
logic_summary: Owned by fd2_chapter_transition_menu. Reset to 0 when the story-chapter intro panel opens. Driven by arrow input inside the menu loop: key 0x4D decrements (wraps to 4 when (int)value < 0), key 0x4B increments (wraps to 0 when (int)value > 4); the wrap uses signed comparison even though the slot is unsigned 32-bit. On a special-hotkey match (input scancode == metadata[2] AND metadata[1] == current state) the value is set to 5. On Enter/Space commit, value != 2 plays the confirm SFX; value == 2 selects the 'save game' branch (no confirm SFX, and after free the function returns 1 only when state != 2). All other functions (render overlay, transition dispatch, sub-menus: buy/sell/equip/give, typeB/typeC, party roster) read this word to decide highlight/branch. Held as a 32-bit word to match the dword loads/stores at the use sites.
element_semantics: Single scalar word holding the menu cursor / commit state: 0..4 = radio menu option index (left/right wrapped); 5 = special-hotkey commit sentinel; 2 = 'save game' branch.
